model_syntax:
# =======================================
  # Reflective Measurement Model
  # =======================================
  Attitude =~ att_appealing + att_desirable +
              att_goodidea + att_pleasant
  PBC =~ pbc_barrier + pbc_could +
         pbc_resources
  DescriptiveNorms =~ norms_d_many + norms_d_common +
                      norms_d_few
  InjunctiveNorms =~ norms_i_consider + norms_i_bad +
                     norms_i_support


  Symbolism =~ symb_envresp + symb_modern
  EnvOrientation =~ aoc_transport + aoc_overstated + aoc_minor + ben_env_reduce + ben_env_shift + ben_env_nodiff
  
  Inst_trust =~ reactance_interfere + reactance_rulesharm + reactance_commongood + reactance_individual + 
                antiintel_commonsense + antiintel_facts + antiintel_expertshelp

  Intention =~ nextv_bev + nextv_phev + nextv_icev
  

  # =======================================
  # Reflective utility constructs
  # =======================================
  
  PowerPerc =~ bev_better_towing +
             bev_better_roughroad +
             bev_better_accel +
             bev_better_power
  
  NonPowerPerc =~ bev_better_comfort +
               bev_better_safety +
               bev_better_reliability
           
  Compatibility =~ fit_hh_prosp_fit +
                    fit_hh_prosp_plan +
                    fit_hh_prosp_shortnotice +
                    fit_hh_prosp_emergency

  RangeConc =~ range_prosp_routine +
               range_prosp_longtrip +
               range_prosp_cold +
               range_prosp_hills

  EVSE_perc =~ find_evse_prosp_nearby +
               find_evse_prosp_longtrip +
               find_evse_prosp_schedule

  Observability =~ observ_evs +
                   observ_charging +
                   observ_stations


  # =======================================
  # Structural path
  # ======================================= 
  Intention ~ d1*Attitude + PBC + d2*InjunctiveNorms + DescriptiveNorms 
  Attitude ~  b1*EnvOrientation + Symbolism + e1*Inst_trust + PowerPerc + NonPowerPerc + Compatibility + RangeConc + Observability + EVSE_perc  + trial_comp + cost_comp
  PBC ~ PowerPerc + NonPowerPerc + Compatibility + RangeConc + EVSE_perc  + trial_comp + cost_comp
  EnvOrientation ~ g*Inst_trust 
  DescriptiveNorms ~ Observability + Compatibility
  InjunctiveNorms ~  Symbolism + Inst_trust + EnvOrientation + Compatibility


  # =======================================
  # Covariance path
  # ======================================= 
  Attitude ~~ PBC
  Attitude ~~ DescriptiveNorms
  Attitude ~~ InjunctiveNorms
  
  InjunctiveNorms ~~ PBC
  InjunctiveNorms ~~ DescriptiveNorms

  EnvOrientation ~~ PBC
  EnvOrientation ~~ DescriptiveNorms
  EnvOrientation ~~ Symbolism
  
  # Additional exo covars for coposites
  trial_comp ~~ RangeConc + Compatibility + Observability + EVSE_perc + PowerPerc + NonPowerPerc + cost_comp + Inst_trust
  cost_comp ~~ RangeConc + Compatibility + Observability + EVSE_perc + PowerPerc + NonPowerPerc + Inst_trust

  # In addition, all exo ~~ exo allowed with auto.cov.lv.x = TRUE
